result.summary: The page looks mostly intact, with a couple of minor visual clipping issues in horizontally scrollable restaurant cards near the right and bottom edges.

issues.description: The third card in the "Fastest near you" row is clipped on the right edge, so the restaurant name is truncated and the card looks cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add a bit more right padding/margin to the horizontal list or ensure the card is fully visible at the current viewport width.

issues.description: The next restaurant card below "Popular right now" is partially hidden at the bottom of the screen, making the content feel cramped near the fixed bottom navigation.
issues.suggestion: Add extra bottom spacing to the scrollable content so cards are not visually crowded by the persistent bottom nav bar.
